data.name: Barafi
data.gender_notes: Barafi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'B-R-F', meaning 'to be frosty, icy, or cool'. This name is associated with the prophet Ibrahim's (AS) faith and steadfastness, symbolizing a strong, unwavering spirit. The name Barafi carries the meaning “Frosty, icy, cool” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Barafi usually hope their child will grow to embody frosty, icy, cool and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to maintain a cool, steadfast heart in times of trials.
data.etymology: Barafi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Frosty, icy, cool.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barafi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: بارفي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من برف، يدل على البرودة والسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ذو أصول عربية، مشتق من كلمة برف التي تعبر عن البرودة والهدوء، ويرتبط بالسلام والطمأنينة، وقد ورد في بعض الآثار الإسلامية القديمة كوصف للجنة أو الأنهار الجارية، ويدل على معاني الرفاهية والسكون.

in_urdu.name: بارفی
in_urdu.meaning: بارف سے مشتق، معنی ٹھنڈا، پرسکون اور سلامتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی جڑوں سے مشتق، برف کے معنی میں جو ٹھنڈک اور سکون کی علامت ہے، اسلامی تقالید میں برف کو اکثر موسم جنت یا نعمت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام روحانی معنی میں سکون اور اندرونی سکون کی خواہش کو ظاہر کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: बारफी
in_hindi.meaning: बारफ से लिया गया, अर्थ शीतल, शांत और सुरक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ बर्फ से जुड़ा है, जो शीतलता और शांति का प्रतीक है, इस्लामी परंपरा में बर्फ़ का उपयोग अक्सर जन्नत या आध्यात्मिक शीतलता के संदर्भ में किया जाता है, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक शांति और आंतरिक शीतलता की इच्छा को दर्शाता है.

in_pashto.name: بارفي
in_pashto.meaning: د برف څخه مشتق شوی، معنی يې يخ، ارام او خوندیتوب
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ريښو څخه مشتق شوی، برف په معنی دی چی د سړک او آرام نښه ده، په اسلامي دود کې برف اکثرا د جنت يا روحاني سړک د نښانې په توګه کارول کیږي، دا نوم روحاني معنی کې د ارام او داخلي سړک غوښتنه څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Barafi
in_english.meaning: Derived from Barf, signifying coldness, peace and security

data.cultural_impact: The name Barafi may be of Persian origin and has been used historically in the Middle East, particularly in the Arab world. In this cultural context, the name Barafi may evoke the memory of extreme cold desert regions or frosty winter nights, with their unique beauty and challenge to human endurance.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Barafi may be seen as a reminder of Prophet Ibrahim's unwavering faith and unwavering spirit. The Prophet Ibrahim was known for his unrelenting commitment to God, even when faced with seemingly impossible tasks such as building the Kaaba in Mecca or enduring the trials of God. Like the unyielding ice described by the name, the spiritual significance of Barafi emphasizes the importance of keeping our faith strong and unyielding in the face of life's challenges and adversities. Additionally, the name may be seen as a reflection of the cool, calm, and collected presence of mind that comes with a strong faith.
